verdicts: MALICIOUS for all three standalone artifacts
method: Read RULES.md and TAXONOMY.md; run atomscan and cleave facts for every original; inspect source, literals, calls, flow limitations and decoded/expanded material; trace paths without running native payloads. Scanner scores are not verdict evidence.

samples.reason: An unsolicited document-opening error popup is launched before a hidden PowerShell download and quiet installation of a ScreenConnect-named MSI. The script requests ordinary UAC approval and removes both installer and popup script. Legitimate RMM products and silent installers are dual-use; the document pretext concealing an unrelated installation tips the standalone artifact to malicious.
execution_trace: Assign agent and notice paths under TEMP.
net session failure launches hidden PowerShell to request Start-Process of %~f0 with Verb RunAs, then exits the original batch. This is a UAC request, not a bypass.
Echo a two-line WSH popup script, start wscript.exe, download the MSI to the agent path, and invoke msiexec /i on the same variable with /qn /norestart.
Wait five seconds, then delete the MSI and notice script. The four-second popup does not establish that it conceals the entire installation.
samples.limitations: The downloaded MSI was not supplied. Forager attempted the exact embedded GitHub URL and received HTTP 404. No installer contents, vendor signature, installed service, payload capabilities or eventual remote control are claimed.

classifier.agreement: Calibrated classifier alerts before and after

samples.reason: A button advertised as a desktop application download writes a native command to the clipboard and then reveals Terminal or Win+R paste-and-execute instructions. The Mac command streams an external shell script into zsh; every non-Mac User-Agent receives remote MSHTA. Consent to download is repurposed into command execution. Ordinary disclosed command-copy installation documentation is a tested benign near miss.
execution_trace: On a download-button click, evaluate the User-Agent regex and select one of the two command constants.
Await navigator.clipboard.writeText(command). Only after that resolves, reveal the corresponding hidden help section.
The browser never directly runs the shell command; the user is instructed to do so in Terminal or Win+R.
Inert browser mocks confirm Macintosh -> curl|zsh; Windows and Linux -> MSHTA. These results corroborate the statically traced branch.
samples.limitations: Both delivery hosts use .invalid. No downstream script or HTA bytes are supplied or recovered. No theft, persistence, final payload identity, or successful native execution follows from this page alone.

classifier.agreement: Calibrated classifier alert miss remains despite four static hostile traits

samples.identification: Concealed Telegram screen/process collector and executable stager
samples.reason: The script combines a Windows-system-lookalike staging path, Defender scan exclusion, an HKCU Run value, hidden execution of a downloaded executable, process inventory, primary-screen capture, ZIP staging and Telegram document upload. The covert staging and defense/persistence combination tips the surveillance behavior to malicious. The Telegram update responses are unused, so this is not demonstrated remote task dispatch.
execution_trace: Construct stage, executable and archive paths; configure Telegram host/token/chat. Create a named mutex but never inspect createdNew to enforce a singleton.
Create the stage directory, request its Defender exclusion, and write the executable path to an HKCU Run property. No elevation request occurs in this script.
Resolve a Telegram file path, build the file API URL, download to the implant variable and immediately Start-Process that same variable with Hidden window style.
Serialize Get-Process Name/Id/Path to processes.json; capture PrimaryScreen via Bitmap/Graphics.CopyFromScreen and save desktop.png.
Compress both of those files to the archive variable and upload Get-Item of that same archive via sendDocument.
The final loop only requests getUpdates and sleeps; it does not use updates, execute their contents, repeat screenshot capture, or repeat the earlier file retrieval.
samples.limitations: The remoteFile variable is unassigned here, the bot token looks like a placeholder, and the script suppresses errors. Authentication, path creation, Defender permissions, payload acquisition and successful upload are not established. There is no observed command dispatch, UAC bypass, or single-instance enforcement.

classifier.agreement: Calibrated classifier alerts before and after
